snippet.title: Nioh 3 - Announcement Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Experience the rise of a heroic Shogun in Nioh 3, the latest entry in the dark samurai action RPG series.  
Fight using two distinct combat styles -- Samurai and Ninja -- as you battle against formidable yokai in an intense open field setting.

Coming in 2026. 

■Download the Nioh 3 Alpha Demo from the PlayStation Store
